scope: live VLM+LLM source caption and weather prompt only; no Cosmos inference or output-quality claim; live sampled-weather checks of unchanged sunny source as negative/positive controls

parameters.instruction: Change only the weather; preserve the scene and recorded motion.

prompt: The video presents a static, elevated, high-angle view of a city intersection under overcast weather conditions, with the same scene layout, objects, and vehicle movements preserved as in the original sunny recording—cloudy lighting replaces bright daylight, shadows are diffused or absent, and the overall color tone becomes cooler and more muted while all motion and camera position remain unchanged.
